items.a: Zippo is a streaming app for mini dramas: full stories told in short, vertical episodes of about one minute each.
Soon! Join the waitlist and you'll be the first to know, with early access before the public launch.
Zippo is free to download, and the first episodes of every show are free. You can unlock more with coins or a membership.
Most episodes run one to three minutes. A full series usually has 50 to 100 episodes.

items.q: Which devices can I watch on?
items.a: iPhone and Android at launch. Web and TV apps will follow.
Subtitles and dubbed audio in 12 languages at launch, with more on the way.

items.q: What do I get for joining the waitlist?
items.a: Early access before public launch, free coins on your first day, and first looks at new shows.

items.q: Can I download episodes to watch offline?
items.a: Offline viewing is planned for members shortly after launch.

about.description: Zippo is building the home of mini dramas: big stories, told one minute at a time.
about.heading: Big stories, one minute at a time
about.lead: We believe the best stories don't need two hours. They need a hook, a heart and a cliffhanger that won't let go.

sections.title: Why we're building Zippo
sections.body: Hundreds of millions of people already watch drama on their phones in short bursts. Zippo is built for that from the ground up: vertical, fast and impossible to put down.

sections.title: What we make
sections.body: Original series across romance, revenge, thriller, fantasy and more, produced with studios and storytellers around the world.

sections.title: Where we're going
sections.body: One app, every language, stories from everywhere. We're starting with a slate of originals and growing from there.
